gloss: to wrap a bandage; to bandage

definitions.gloss: to wrap a bandage; to bandage
definitions.explanation: To wind a bandage around a wound or injured body part.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}く。
examples.english: To wrap a bandage around the wound.

examples.japanese: ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手首|てくび}→手首：01000_tekubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}いて⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The nurse wrapped a bandage around my wrist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}→応急手当：29914_oukyuuteate⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{清潔|せいけつ}→清潔：01583_seiketsu⟧な⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ハンカチ→ハンカチ：02937_hankachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{代用|だいよう}→代用：16439_daiyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}いた。
examples.english: As first aid, since there was no clean cloth available, I used a handkerchief as a substitute and wrapped it as a bandage.

notes:
The standard expression for applying a bandage in Japanese. ⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to wind, to wrap) is the most natural verb to use with ⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧ (bandage), reflecting the winding motion of wrapping a bandage around a body part.

For removing a bandage, use ⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ (to remove a bandage) or ⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take off a bandage).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きつく→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to wrap a bandage tightly
- {包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}き{直|なお}す: to rewrap a bandage
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}く: to bandage an arm
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}く: to wrap a bandage around the head

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絆創膏|ばんそうこう}→絆創膏：05386_bansoukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to put on a bandage/plaster — for small wounds, using adhesive bandages
- ⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give first aid — broader term for treating an injury
- ⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to remove a bandage — the opposite action
